title: Base Rate of a Mobile Wallet Wrong-Wallet Re-Credit by Length of Investigation
content:
Treasury rate-basis note for **Mobile Wallet** wrong-wallet re-credits.

**Rule.** The investigation runs in calendar days from the notice date (the customer's latest wrong-wallet error notice on the transfer) to the date of the error-found decision, and its length sets the base rate of the re-credit:

| Investigation length | Base rate |
|---|---|
| 5 calendar days or more | the booking-day mid-market rate implied by the locked rate: the locked rate divided by one minus the margin the transfer carried over 100, rounded half up to 4 decimals |
| at least 2 and fewer than 5 calendar days | the locked rate multiplied by one plus 0.5 times that margin over 100, rounded half up to 4 decimals |
| fewer than 2 calendar days | the locked rate |

The margin a wrongly credited transfer carried is the tier's exchange-rate margin, less the tier's reduction in percentage points when the principal collected on the transfer (its funds-received entries) is at or above the tier's reduction threshold.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: locked rate 55.0000, margin carried 1.70 percent, notice dated 2026-03-02)

| Error-found decision dated | Days | Base rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-03 | 1 | 55.0000 |
| 2026-03-04 | 2 | 55.0000 multiplied by 1.0085 is 55.4675 |
| 2026-03-06 | 4 | 55.4675 |
| 2026-03-07 | 5 | 55.0000 divided by 0.983 is 55.951169..., rounded to 55.9512 |
